evidence.claim: Groundwater dissolved the limestone into caverns until a roof collapsed, exposing the water below. Pressurized groundwater feeds the resulting artesian pool.
evidence.quote: The Blue Hole is an example of a natural artesian well, a type of well or spring fed by water under high pressure, and of a cenote, a collapsed cavern exposing groundwater beneath. The cavern was formed by the dissolution of the limestone bedrock by groundwater, carving caverns into the rock until the roof caved in.
